verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents built-in event-triggered automations: accepting a quote can automatically convert it to an invoice and send it, and payment reminders can be automated. There is no evidence of a general user-defined rule or workflow engine with custom triggers, conditions and actions. Scheduled and recurring invoices are time-based, not event-based, so they do not count toward this story. Missing for 10: user-definable workflow rules with custom triggers/conditions, configurable action types (e.g., field updates, webhooks, custom functions), documentation of rule configuration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
